title: Decide the vehicle for taking follower catch-up to the MIMI working group
description:
docs/design/mimi-catchup.md §12.2. Two vehicles were weighed for the
catch-up primitive once mimid implements it:

1. Text proposed for protocol-08, patching the WG's own draft.
2. A separate extension draft, draft-atwood-mimi-catchup.
   (A third option, raising the gap on the list with no text and letting
   the WG pick the vehicle, was also offered.)

DECIDED by Mark, 2026-11-22: (1), text for protocol-08, with mimid's
implementation as the evidence.

Why: the hole is in the WG's own draft. A follower provider that is
unreachable during fanout permanently loses an MLS application
ciphertext -- the hub cannot regenerate it and no other party can mint
it -- and protocol-07 does not even tell the follower it should say so.
That is a correctness gap in the base protocol, not an optional
feature, and the argument is weakened by filing it as an optional
add-on: proposing it as an extension concedes that it is optional. In
the base draft every implementation gets it and nothing has to be
negotiated.

Cost accepted: protocol-08 text moves on the WG's schedule rather than
Mark's.

NOT AUTHORIZATION TO POST. Per AGENTS.md and the peer-contributing
rules, every upstream post needs Mark's own per-action OK, and the
target's CONTRIBUTING/SECURITY text is read first. This bead settles
only which container the work aims at.
